about_the_game:
You wake up in the middle of an accident in the secret facility you work in.

The old radio station will be your safe point. But the radio is broken.

Look for blueprints, materials and items to craft the missing part, repair the radio and call for help.

The game is a survival explore looting crafting game.

The Goal:

  • Craft the missing radio part to call for help.

Survival:

  • Keep an eye on your health, energy, food, and water.

  • Find food, water, and helpful items to survive.

  • Return to your base to rest and fully replenish your energy.

Exploration:

  • Break crates on a grid. When you break a few, items will appear.

  • Rotate the grid and move your character to reach the items and put them in your backpack.

  • Each time you break crates, you'll attract different enemies with different attacks.

  • Avoid them while moving or use your weapons to eliminate them.

Loot:

  • Explore various locations on the island with different loot deposits.

  • Each run make the places has a different number of floors and levels.

  • There are common items, basic materials, and crafting blueprints to find.

  • The further you go from the ground floor, the higher your chances of finding blueprints.

Crafting:

  • Find blueprints to learn how to craft items.

  • Recycle weapons, ammunition, and other items to obtain materials.

  • Use the fabrication machine to combine materials into more complex objects.

  • You decide what to make and when.

  • Build the radio missing part to exit the island

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: 2.5Ghz or better
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 180 MB available space

short_description: Rotate the grid and break groups of boxes to move your character, loot items and avoid enemies. Explore places with different loot and levels. Recycle items to get materials and craft new ones until you fix the radio and ask for help. A Rogue-lite Survival Explore Looting Crafting game.
